reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that monitors run and interaction events and delivers configurable desktop notifications and system sounds.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在运行结束、模型提问或等待审批时发送可配置的桌面通知与系统提示音。
summaries.en: Sends configurable desktop notifications and system sounds from DeepSeek Harness when runs finish or require questions and approvals.

capabilities: Listens to DeepSeek Harness session and agent status events
Sends desktop notifications for run completion, questions, and approvals
Invokes platform notification and sound commands through detached child processes
Provides configurable notification behavior and quiet hours in the web GUI
